ios.desc:
Old School RuneScape 

Old School RuneScape is the iconic fantasy MMORPG that defined a generation. Based on the original 2007 version of RuneScape, this is the only major MMO RPG shaped entirely by its players, with new content voted into the game by the community. 

With over 300 million accounts created since 2001, RuneScape remains one of the world’s most played online role-playing games. Whether you're new to Gielinor or returning for the nostalgia, Old School RuneScape delivers a deep, evolving sandbox RPG adventure. 

Master 24 Skills, Including Sailing 

Train across 24 unique skills, including the new Sailing skill. Captain your own ship, explore uncharted islands, and uncover powerful rewards on the open sea. 

From Combat and Slayer to Fishing, Runecrafting, and Sailing, this open-world MMORPG offers true progression and freedom. 

Choose your path: 
• Max every skill
• Build a PvP account
• Play as an Ironman
• Or explore at your own pace 

This is your MMO, play your way. 

Epic Quests & Story Adventures 

Embark on hundreds of immersive quests filled with humour, danger, and rich fantasy storytelling. Solve mysteries, defeat legendary foes, and shape your character’s legacy. 

From early-game beginner quests to Grandmaster challenges, Old School RuneScape delivers classic RPG quest design with modern depth. 

Bosses, Raids & Endgame PvM 

Take on powerful bosses and conquer epic raids, including: 
• Chambers of Xeric 
• Theatre of Blood 
• Tombs of Amascut 

Whether you're learning how to survive your first raid, or you're chasing the title of raid master, Old School RuneScape offers some of the most rewarding PvM in any MMORPG. 

Explore a Vast Open World MMO 

Adventure across the enormous world of Gielinor, from desert kingdoms and haunted swamps to tropical islands and now the open seas. 

Every region unlocks new training methods, bosses, skilling activities, and unforgettable quests in this living fantasy MMO. 

True Cross-Platform Gameplay 

Play Old School RuneScape on mobile and desktop with one account across the same game worlds. Skill on the go, complete a quest on mobile, then raid on desktop, your progress stays with you. 

Free-to-Play or Become a Member 

Start your adventure for free, or unlock the full MMORPG experience with Membership: 
• 9 additional skills 
• Hundreds more quests 
• Exclusive bosses and raids 
• Expanded world map and bank space 

Download Old School RuneScape today and begin your adventure in the world’s
